spotifycontrol.config.title: Spotify Control Settings
spotifycontrol.config.hud.enabled.toolti: Show or hide the Spotify HUD overlay entirely.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.anchor.tooltip: Default corner of the screen the HUD anchors to. Each element can override this.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.offset_x.toolt: Default horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.offset_y.toolt: Default vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.opacity.toolti: Opacity of the HUD background panel (0 - 255).
Rounding of panel corners in pixels (0 = square).
spotifycontrol.config.hud.card_width.too: Width of the now-playing card in pixels (80 - 480).
spotifycontrol.config.hud.panel_style.to: How the background panel behind each element is painted.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.progress_style: How the played portion of the progress bar is drawn.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.text_color.too: ARGB hex color for primary text. The alpha channel is honoured.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.secondary_colo: ARGB hex color for artist names and timestamps.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.tertiary_color: ARGB hex color for album, device and hint text.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.accent_color.t: ARGB hex color for the progress fill, status glyph and lyrics highlight.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.background_col: ARGB hex base color of the panel; the alpha here is the panel alpha.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.border_color.t: ARGB hex color of the panel outline.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.text_shadow.to: Draw a drop shadow behind HUD text.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_album_art: Render the downloaded album artwork on the card.
Render the track progress bar with elapsed/total time.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_album_nam: Add the album as a third text row on the card.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_time.tool: Show the timestamp row next to the progress bar.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_device.to: Show which device is currently playing.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_repeat.to: Show the active repeat mode next to the device line.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.show_play_puls: Gently pulse the status glyph while music is playing.
spotifycontrol.config.hud.marquee.toolti: Marquee-scroll text that is wider than the element.
Marquee scroll speed in pixels per second (5 - 200).
spotifycontrol.config.elements.descripti: Every HUD element can be placed and styled on its own. Fields show the value currently in effect; changing one stores an explicit per-element value. Use Reset to fall back to the global HUD settings.
spotifycontrol.config.element.card.ancho: Corner of the screen this element is pinned to.
spotifycontrol.config.element.card.offse: Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.card.text_: Primary text color for this element.
Draw a drop shadow behind this element's text.
spotifycontrol.config.element.card.marqu: Marquee-scroll overflowing text in this element.
spotifycontrol.config.element.card.reset: Clear every per-element override and inherit the global HUD settings again.
spotifycontrol.config.element.mini.ancho: Corner of the screen this element is pinned to.
spotifycontrol.config.element.mini.offse: Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Maximum width of the mini bar in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.mini.text_: Draw a drop shadow behind this element's text.
spotifycontrol.config.element.mini.marqu: Marquee-scroll overflowing text in this element.
spotifycontrol.config.element.mini.reset: Clear every per-element override and inherit the global HUD settings again.
spotifycontrol.config.element.progress.a: Corner of the screen this element is pinned to.
spotifycontrol.config.element.progress.o: Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.progress.t: Draw a drop shadow behind this element's text.
spotifycontrol.config.element.progress.m: Marquee-scroll overflowing text in this element.
spotifycontrol.config.element.progress.r: Clear every per-element override and inherit the global HUD settings again.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.anchor: Corner of the screen this element is pinned to.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.offset: Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.size.t: Side length of the artwork tile in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.text_c: Color used while no artwork is available.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.text_s: Draw a drop shadow behind this element's text.
spotifycontrol.config.element.art.marque: Marquee-scroll overflowing text in this element.
Clear every per-element override and inherit the global HUD settings again.
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.anc: Corner of the screen this element is pinned to.
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.off: Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels.
Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels.
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.tex: Draw a drop shadow behind this element's text.
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.mar: Marquee-scroll lyric lines that do not fit.
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.lyr: How many lyric lines this element shows at once (1 - 11).
spotifycontrol.config.element.lyrics.res: Clear every per-element override and inherit the global HUD settings again.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.enabled.too: Fetch and show lyrics for the track that is playing.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.source.tool: Where synced lyrics come from. The Spotify Web API exposes no lyrics endpoint.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.offset.tool: Shift the lyrics timeline forward or backward by up to 30 seconds.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.lines.toolt: How many lyric lines the lyrics element shows at once (1 - 11).
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.karaoke.too: Fill the active line progressively as the track advances.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.uppercase.t: Render every lyric line in capitals.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.placeholder: Show a status line when no lyrics are available instead of hiding the element.
ARGB hex color for lines that are not being sung.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.active_colo: ARGB hex color for the line currently being sung.
spotifycontrol.config.lyrics.reload.tool: Clear the lyrics cache and fetch the current track again.
spotifycontrol.config.api.client_id.tool: Client ID of your Spotify application (PKCE - no client secret is ever stored).
Local port used to capture the OAuth authorization code. Must match a Redirect URI in your Spotify app.
How often the currently playing track is refreshed (1 - 60 seconds).
spotifycontrol.config.api.login.tooltip: Open the browser and authorize this mod with your Spotify account.
spotifycontrol.config.api.fallback.toolt: Use native OS media controls (SMTC / MPRIS) when not authenticated with the Web API.
spotifycontrol.config.api.local_fallback: Use native OS media controls (SMTC / MPRIS) when not authenticated with the Web API. Playback position is unavailable on that backend, so lyrics and the progress bar degrade.
spotifycontrol.config.keybinds.descripti: Keybinds are managed by Minecraft itself; the buttons below jump straight to the relevant screens.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.enabled.toolti: When an advertisement is detected, the Spotify desktop app is closed and reopened, which drops the ad slot and resumes playback. Off by default: podcast episodes and local files can also report an unknown artist.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.trigger.toolti: Which signal marks a track as an ad. 'Unknown artist' catches most ad slots; 'keywords' catches localised ad titles; 'either' combines both.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.keywords.toolt: Comma or semicolon separated words matched against the title, artist and album (whole words only, so 'Radio' or 'Bad' stay safe).
spotifycontrol.config.ads.cooldown.toolt: Minimum gap between two automatic restarts, so a stuck ad cannot restart Spotify in a loop.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.max_per_hour.t: Hard cap on automatic restarts inside any rolling hour.
Grace period between closing Spotify and launching it again.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.notify.tooltip: Print a chat message whenever the advertisement skipper acts.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.resume.tooltip: Press play after the relaunch when Spotify came back paused.
spotifycontrol.config.ads.test_restart.t: Close and reopen the local Spotify client right away, ignoring cooldown limits, to verify the restart recipe works on this machine.
spotifycontrol.config.debug.enabled.tool: Log every Spotify request and native media query to the game log.
spotifycontrol.config.debug.test_local.t: Query the native media session once and print the result to the game log.
